section3.title: Progressive tiers and added cost
items: PC usage is added on top of your household's existing usage, so heavy-usage homes pay the pricier tier per kWh.
Above 200 kWh (300 in summer) you move to tier 2, above 400 kWh (450 in summer) to tier 3; base charge and unit rate both rise.
In tier 3, each PC kWh adds about 360 KRW including taxes and fund.
Find your household usage on your electricity bill or the KEPCO ON app.
